body:
Self-contained specification for 348-case bracket/backref-free sed_file subset and notebook_edit / notebook_execution policy (building on goFoldKey / normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive exported by predecessor ticket t-policy-1-5-9-readonly-and-plugin-data):

1. `hooks/policy/constants.mjs`:
   - Add `'notebook_edit'` to `PATH_MUTATING_TOOLS` and `TOOL_PATH_SCHEMAS.notebook_edit = { required: ['NotebookPath'], altRequired: ['notebookPath'] }`; add notebook content/metadata keys (`CellContent`, `NewSource`, `Source`, `Cells`, `CellId`, `CellID`, `EditMode`, `CellType`) to `EXCLUDED_CONTENT_KEYS` (ensure neither `sed_file` nor `notebook_edit` can ever act as a `.adlc/tickets` shard writer).
   - Export `SED_ALLOWED_KEYS = new Set(['target_file', 'targetfile', 'expressions', 'file_content', 'filecontent', 'toolaction', 'toolsummary'])` and `NOTEBOOK_EXEC_TOOLS = new Set(['notebook_execution'])`.

2. `hooks/policy/evaluate.mjs`:
   - Export `validateSedCall(expressions)`:
     - Require `Array.isArray(expressions) && expressions.length >= 1 && expressions.length <= 128`.
     - Every item `expr` must satisfy `typeof expr === 'string' && expr.length >= 1 && expr.length <= 1024 && !/[\0\r\n]/.test(expr)` (no `.trim()`).
     - Each `expr` must match EITHER:
       (A) Line/range delete: `/^(?:[1-9]\d*|\$)(?:,(?:[1-9]\d*|\$))?d$/`, OR
       (B) Bounded substitution: optional leading address `/^(?:[1-9]\d*|\$)(?:,(?:[1-9]\d*|\$))?/` followed immediately by `'s'` + `delim` where `delim === '/' || delim === '|'`; let `rest` be the substring after `delim`, split literally via `parts = rest.split(delim)` requiring `parts.length === 3` (`[pattern, replacement, flags]` — literal `split(delim)` intentionally forbids any occurrence of the chosen `delim`, even backslash-escaped, inside `pattern` or `replacement` so JS and GNU `sed` cannot disagree on delimiter boundaries; callers needing literal `|` use `/` as `delim` as in vector 22 `"s/a\\|b/c/g"`, whereas vector 21 `"s|a\\|b|c|g"` splits to length 4 and is denied!), `1 <= pattern.length <= 256`, `replacement.length <= 512`, `!/[\[\]]/.test(pattern)` (no BRE bracket expressions), `!/\\[1-9]/.test(pattern)` (no BRE backreferences), neither `pattern` nor `replacement` ending in an odd backslash run (`!/(?:^|[^\\])(?:\\\\)*\\$/.test(pattern)` and `!/(?:^|[^\\])(?:\\\\)*\\$/.test(replacement)`), and `/^(?:g|[1-9]\d*|p|I|i|m|M)*$/.test(flags)`.
     - Return `{ ok: true }` or `{ ok: false, reason }` (any non-empty descriptive reason string).
   - Export `evaluateSedFile(rawArgs, ctx)` and dispatch `if (name === 'sed_file') return evaluateSedFile(args, ctx);` in `evaluatePayload`:
     - Col 1 (`ctx.readonly`) -> `deny('Mutating tool sed_file denied in read-only worker session')`.
     - Validate `norm = normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive(rawArgs)` (`!norm.ok` -> `deny(norm.reason)`).
     - Enforce closed key set `SED_ALLOWED_KEYS`; reject if both `target_file` and `targetfile` or both `file_content` and `filecontent` are present; require `file_content`/`filecontent` to be `undefined`, `null`, or `{}` (`typeof fc === 'object' && !Array.isArray(fc) && Object.keys(fc).length === 0`); require `target = norm.folded.target_file ?? norm.folded.targetfile` to be a non-empty trimmed `string`.
     - Run `validateSedCall(norm.folded.expressions)` **unconditionally across all 5 context columns** (`!sedCheck.ok` -> `deny(sedCheck.reason)`).
     - Resolve `toPath(target)` via `resolveAll`: if any resolved candidate lies inside `.adlc/tickets` (via `repoRelative` covering `TICKET_STORE_DIR`), return `deny('Target path matches standing ADLC implicit rail: .adlc/tickets/')` (`sed_file` is never a shard writer); then evaluate `const v = evaluateFileTool('write_to_file', { TargetFile: target }, ctx)` and return `v.decision === 'ask' ? deny(v.reason ?? 'sed_file requires unambiguous pass') : v` so every cell returns strictly `'deny'` or `'pass'`.
   - Update `notebook_edit` handling so any resolved candidate inside `.adlc/tickets` also returns `deny('Target path matches standing ADLC implicit rail: .adlc/tickets/')` and any `'ask'` verdict from `evaluateFileTool` is converted via `v.decision === 'ask' ? deny(v.reason) : v`.
   - Export `evaluateNotebookExecution(rawArgs, ctx)` and dispatch `if (NOTEBOOK_EXEC_TOOLS.has(name)) return evaluateNotebookExecution(args, ctx);`:
     - Cols 1 (`ctx.readonly`), 2 (`ctx.workerTicket`), and 3 (`repo.adlc && (repo.activeRail || !repo.store.ok)`) -> **hard `deny`**.
     - Validate `norm = normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive(rawArgs)`, closed keys `{ notebookpath, absolutepath, path, cellids, toolaction, toolsummary }`, non-empty string notebook path (`np`), optional `cellids` array of strings; resolve `toPath(np)` via `resolveAll` + `gateOnePath` (denying missing anchor, protected roots, booster data roots, implicit rails, or any `repo.adlc && (repo.activeRail || !repo.store.ok)`), returning strictly `deny(...)` or `PASS` (`0` `ask` verdicts).

3. Independent-Oracle 348-Case Differential Suite (`test/policy-1-5-9-sed-notebook.test.mjs`):
   - Test all 5 context columns (1: `readonly`, 2: `workerTicket`, 3: interactive ADLC with active rails, 4: interactive ADLC without active rails, 5: non-ADLC) for `sed_file`, `notebook_edit`, and `notebook_execution` via `evaluatePayload`, including symlinked rail escape denial and `.adlc/tickets/` shard denial.
   - Implement the exact **324-case cartesian suite**: `delims=['/','|',','] (3) * addrs=['','1,5','/re/'] (3) * patterns=['foo','','a[b','[a/b]','a\\','a\\\\'] (6) * replacements=['bar','bar\\','x;e'] (3) * flags=['g','ge'] (2) = 324`, asserting `validateSedCall([expr]).ok` equals `(delim === '/' || delim === '|') && (addr === '' || addr === '1,5') && (pattern === 'foo' || pattern === 'a\\\\') && (replacement === 'bar' || replacement === 'x;e') && flag === 'g'` and asserting exact totals `16` `ACCEPT` and `308` `DENY`.
   - Implement all **24 verbatim fixed vectors** (`6 ACCEPT`: `"1d"`, `"$d"`, `"1,$d"`, `"s/a\\|b/c/g"`, `"s|foo/bar|&\\nbaz|g"`, `"s/foo/bar/2pIm"`; `18 DENY`: `"0d"`, `"1,2d;3d"`, `"{1d}"`, `"1!d"`, `"e"`, `"e touch pwn"`, `"s/foo/bar/e"`, `"s/foo/bar/w pwn"`, `"s/foo/bar/W pwn"`, `"w pwn"`, `"W pwn"`, `"1r /etc/passwd"`, `"1R /etc/passwd"`, `"F"`, `"z"`, `"s/(a)\\1/b/g"`, `"s/foo/bar/\0"`, `"s|a\\|b|c|g"`), plus length-bound tests (`pattern` 257 chars -> deny, `replacement` 513 chars -> deny).
   - Execute all `22` (`16 + 6`) accepted expressions via `spawnSync('sed', ['-i', expr, tmpFile], { timeout: 2000 })` (on `process.platform === 'linux'`, fail hard if `sed` is absent) starting from exact seed text `const SEED = 'L1 foo foo a\\b a|b foo/bar\nL2 FOO foo\nL3 mid\nL4 last\n';`: assert `status === 0`, `signal === null`, `readdirSync(tmpDir)` equals `[basename(tmpFile)]` (zero extra files created), and explicitly verify transformed file contents on the key vectors (`"1d"` removes `L1`, `"$d"` removes `L4`, `"1,$d"` produces `''`, `"s|foo/bar|&\\nbaz|g"` produces `'foo/bar\nbaz'`, `"s/foo/bar/2pIm"` replaces the 2nd `foo` on `L1`, and every cartesian `foo -> bar` / `a\\ -> x;e` substitution produces the exact deterministic JS string replacement on `L1`–`L4`).
   - Run `npm run build && npm test && npm run plugin:validate`.

edges.contract: T2 exports validateSedCall(expressions), evaluateSedFile(rawArgs, ctx), and evaluateNotebookExecution(rawArgs, ctx) in hooks/policy/evaluate.mjs and registers sed_file, notebook_edit, and notebook_execution in hooks/policy/constants.mjs and evaluatePayload(). T3 extends evaluatePayload() and evaluateOrchestrationTool() for send_command_input, manage_task, and subagent tools without modifying validateSedCall, evaluateSedFile, evaluateNotebookExecution, or test/policy-1-5-9-sed-notebook.test.mjs.

title: Enforce 348-case bracket/backref-free sed_file subset and notebook_edit / notebook_execution policy
